description: Lists the phones of the account that Statuser calls when a monitor goes down. A call goes only to a confirmed phone (`status: confirmed`) that is switched on in the project of the monitor (`project_channel_list`) while calls are on in that project (`project_voice_calls_get`). A phone still being confirmed carries `confirmation` — which number to call from it and until when. Phones are added and confirmed in the Statuser panel only.
name: notification_phone_list
title: List phones for outage calls
